move: CSS 3D product box spins a full turn, tilts, with lambert-shaded faces
how: A six-face CSS box (gradient front and back with brand copy, plain sides and caps) sits in a 1400px perspective world over a soft glow and a floor shadow. A seek function sets rotationY to one full 360 per D, rotationX swinging -18 plus or minus 22deg once, rotationZ plus or minus 6deg twice, and a 14px float; the shadow scales and fades with the float and the glow pulses. Each face carries a black shade overlay whose opacity is computed from the face normal against a fixed light after the rotation, so the box appears lit from upper left as it turns. Loop closes since every term is periodic.
adapt: Replace the front and back face gradients and text with the product, resize the box and caps to the product proportions, change the glow colour. Keep one full spin per D and the computed shading.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the world, box faces, glow and shadow; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate applies the rotation, float and per-face shade opacities, replacing fx.register.
caveats: motion is a seek function with computed shading, not tweens; port as a progress tween with onUpdate
backface-visibility and preserve-3d must survive any parent transform in the host
